beats.text: You just moved, and making friends feels slow. Here's the real math.
A researcher asked hundreds of people who had just moved how many hours they spent together.
Stranger to casual friend: about fifty hours.
Close friend: over two hundred hours!
That's months of showing up. It's not you, it's the hours. Because

sources: Hall (2019), How many hours does it take to make a friend?, Journal of Social and Personal Relationships 36(4) – 355 adults who had recently moved + 112 first-year students: ~50 h to casual friend, ~90 h to friend, 200+ h to close friend.
